title: No Cost to Correct

facts.claim: HUD's form combines move-out condition and correction-cost fields with agreement/disagreement routing, specific-item listing, and a resident statement excepting normal wear.
facts.source_selector: turn685308view0 official HUD PDF lines 7-14 and 121-152; turn687790view0 page-4 screenshot

facts.claim: SQLite's current WAL documentation places runtime 3.46.1 within an affected range for a rare race whose documented trigger requires concurrent write/checkpoint activity; the D003 build profile records one connection, no concurrent writer, and no checkpoint during the committed transition.
facts.source_selector: turn103932view0 official SQLite WAL documentation lines 195-218 plus poems/P0003/artifact/d003/WAL_RECEIPT.json execution_profile
facts.draft_exact_string: The packaged Python runtime reports SQLite 3.46.1. SQLite’s current WAL documentation places that version in a range affected by a rare concurrent write/checkpoint WAL-reset race; this build used one connection, no concurrent writer, disabled automatic checkpointing, and no checkpoint during the committed transition, so it did not exercise the documented trigger.
